purpose: Adversarial corpus for the claim-support screens. Three labels, each with a different obligation. 'conflict': the claim opposes its own excerpt and the screen MUST flag it. 'supported': a correct finding the screen MUST NOT flag, because a false conflict there costs a real author an explicit attestation and a confidence level. 'lexically-opposed': semantically supported but lexically opposite ('cannot be used' vs 'will panic'); a lexical screen cannot resolve these, so the screen is EXPECTED to flag them and the label records the method's real boundary instead of tuning it away.
